purpose: Define the framework-agnostic capability registry payload CYNIC uses to understand external agent frameworks without binding organism policy to a provider name.
contract_rules: Capabilities describe what CYNIC can safely route to a framework today; they are not a wishlist.
Framework adapters may observe, declare, or infer capabilities, but must report confidence for each capability.
Provider-specific discovery belongs in organ-contracts adapters or a bounded runtime adapter, not in organ-forge core.
Runtime observations are published through kernel observations or task results, not committed narrative markdown.
Organ business logic consumes capability ids and CYNIC schemas, not framework names.
Hermes Agent is the default framework to scan before CYNIC adds a new agent runtime capability; new local implementations must cite an adapter, sovereignty, security, or policy gap.

provider_policy.fork_policy: Prefer upstream Hermes Agent plus adapters. Maintain a CYNIC fork only when upstream or adapter boundaries cannot satisfy sovereignty, security, policy, or local runtime requirements.
